fullPassage: The common accounts of human nature that float around in society are generally a mixture of assumptions, tales and sometimes plain silliness. However, psychology is different. It is the branch of science that is devoted to understanding people: how and why we act as we do; why we see things as we do; and how we interact with one another. The key word here is 'science.' Psychologists don't depend on opinions and hearsay, or the generally accepted views of society at the time, or even the considered opinions of deep thinkers. Instead, they look for evidence, to make sure that psychological ideas are firmly based, and not just derived from generally held beliefs or assumptions. In addition to this evidence-based approach, psychology deals with fundamental processes and principles that generate our rich cultural and social diversity, as well as those shared by all human beings. These are what modern psychology is all about.

questions.passage: The common accounts of human nature that float around in society are generally a mixture of assumptions, tales and sometimes <u>plain silliness</u>. However, psychology is different. It is the branch of science that is devoted to understanding people: how and why we act as we do; why we see things as we do; and how we interact with one another. The key word here is 'science.' Psychologists don't depend on opinions and hearsay, or the generally accepted views of society at the time, or even the considered opinions of deep thinkers. Instead, they look for evidence, to make sure that psychological ideas are firmly based, and not just derived from generally held beliefs or assumptions. In addition to this evidence-based approach, psychology deals with fundamental processes and principles that generate our rich cultural and social diversity, as well as those shared by all human beings. These are what modern psychology is all about.
questions.stem: 위 글의 밑줄 친 plain silliness가 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ② 아무런 실제 근거가 없는 어리석은 생각
det.analysis:
❌ ① carefully tested scientific conclusions(신중히 검증된 과학적 결론): 통념은 검증되지 않은 것이므로 반대

✅ ② foolish ideas that have no real basis(실제 근거가 없는 어리석은 생각): 인간 본성에 대한 통념이 가정·이야기·'순전한 어리석음'의 혼합이라는 맥락에서, 근거 없는 어리석은 생각을 의미 ←정답

❌ ③ complex philosophical arguments(복잡한 철학적 논증): plain(단순한/순전한)과 어울리지 않음

❌ ④ widely proven psychological laws(널리 입증된 심리 법칙): 증명된 것이 아니므로 반대
det.tip: plain silliness — 근거 없는 순전한 어리석음(검증되지 않은 통념)

ch: foolish ideas that have no real basis

questions.stem: 위 글의 밑줄 친 These가 가리키는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ① 'These are what modern psychology is all about'에서 These는 앞의 evidence-based approach와 fundamental processes and principles를 가리킴
det.analysis:
✅ ① 근본적인 과정과 원리들: 바로 앞 문장의 증거 기반 접근과 'fundamental processes and principles'를 These가 받음 ←정답

❌ ② 사회에 떠도는 통념들: 통념은 심리학과 대비되는 것으로 These가 아님

❌ ③ 사상가들의 의견들: 심리학자가 의존하지 않는 것으로 These가 아님

❌ ④ 인간 본성에 관한 옛 이야기들: 통념의 일부로 These가 가리키는 대상이 아님
det.tip: These = (증거 기반 접근 + 근본 과정·원리) = 현대 심리학의 핵심

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 빈칸: 'the considered opinions of deep thinkers'(깊은 사상가들의 숙고된 의견) — 심리학자가 의존하지 않는 것의 하나
det.analysis:
❌ ① the latest results of careful brain research(최신 뇌 연구 결과): 증거 기반 연구는 심리학자가 의존하는 것이므로 이 자리에 부적합

❌ ② the strict rules made by the government(정부가 만든 엄격한 규칙): 본문과 무관

❌ ③ the personal diaries of their own patients(환자의 개인 일기): 본문과 무관

✅ ④ the considered opinions of deep thinkers: 원문 일치. 심리학자들은 의견·소문·통념뿐 아니라 깊은 사상가의 숙고된 의견조차 의존하지 않는다는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
